scenes.ur: خاتون استانی کے ساتھ آن لائن قرآن کلاسیں
scenes.sub: Assalamu alaikum. Would you like a female Quran teacher for your child?
At Nurul Huda Academy, you can ask for a female teacher for every class.
Our Head of Academics is a Hafiza, and every teacher passes a recitation test.
She can teach from the first letters of the Noorani Qaida to tajweed and hifz.
Classes are live and one to one, with the Quran page on screen.
Ask for a female teacher when you book your free trial at nurulhudaacademy.org
